Print the bundled Seek skill

Part of [`seek`](seek.md).

## Usage

```text
seek skill [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek skill` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek skill --help`:

```text
Usage: seek skill [options]

Print the bundled Seek skill

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```
